Miss Yonge would be obliged if [Messrs Macmillan](/organisation/111) would send to
the [Revd R Bigg Wither](/person/2318)
St Thomas’ Home
Basingstoke
a copy of each of
[The Heir of Redclyffe](/book/15)
[Heartsease](/book/19)
[The Daisy Chain](/book/24)
[The Trial](/book/53)
[Pillars of the House](/book/109)
[Scripture Readings with comment](/book/87)
[Pupils of St John](/book/72)
